name: seal-stamp-confirmation
intent: A stamp descends and strikes a briefing card; the ink mark overshoots then settles to a frozen angle while a confirmation ring pulses once.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Mark appears already settled at −6° FILED; no descent, impact, or ring pulse

acceptance: Stamp descends over descentMs 220 then squashes for impactMs 90
Ink mark scales from 0 with overshootDeg −14 and settles to settleDeg −6 over settleMs 180
Confirmation ring pulses exactly once for ringMs 280 (data-ring) then clears
Replay resets to PENDING with no mark before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows FILED mark at −6° immediately
